newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 12.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- An affiliate of the Saudi Basic Industries Corp signs a lump sum turnkey contract for the engineering, design and installation of furnaces for its Olefins-111 project.
- Bangladesh's foreign minister to pay a two-day visit to Saudi Arabia on June 13.
- Lawyers of two British nurses accused of murdering their Australian colleague say the victim's brother has no right to demand the death penalty.
- Governor of eastern province to inaugurate a 140 million riyal recreation project on Thursday.
- Industry and electricity minister says Saudi has many potential investment opportunities.
